hook: 灯 has fire (火) on the left: a small fire that gives light, like a lamp.
角 is an angle; where two walls meet at an angle is the corner.
Sounds like "I" in "I love you": 愛 is love.
Not (不) over a mouth (口): a mouth saying not, いや, no!
A band or sash: the obi is the wide belt tied around a kimono.
角 means angle: 三角 is a triangle, three angles.
Hand (手) + skill (術): a doctor's skilled hands doing an operation.
Person (人) + thing (物): what kind of thing a person is, their character.
過 means pass: you pass your time, spend the holidays.
Control (制) + rule or measure (度): the rules that control things, a system.
現 means appear: what appears outside is a sign of what is inside.
From (以) before (前): in the past, earlier.
痛 has the sickness sign (疒): the feeling of being sick or hurt, pain.
Depend on (依) + rely on (頼): you rely on someone, so you make a request.
Stamp or mark (印) + print (刷): stamping marks onto paper, printing.
Shadow (影) + echo (響): one thing follows another like a shadow or echo, influence.
感 has heart (心) at the bottom: what your heart feels, to feel.
Write down (記) + thought (念): writing it down to keep the memory, commemoration.
球 has jewel (王, a form of 玉) on the left: a round jewel, a ball.
Save (救) + help (助): saving and helping people, a rescue.
暮 has the sun (日) sinking at the bottom: the day or year getting dark, the year end.
Individual (個) + person (人): one single person, an individual.
Inside (中) a dream (夢): so into something it feels like a dream, totally hooked.
Face (面) + fall over (倒): your face falls, what a bother, trouble.
Brave (勇) + spirit (気): a brave spirit, courage.
Night (夜) + get bright (明け): when the night opens into light, dawn.
Contain (容) + vessel (器): a thing that holds stuff, a container.
Old (老) + person (人): an old person.
輪 has car (車) on the left: a wheel, so a ring or circle.
All (全) + country (国): the whole country, nationwide.
Body (体) + raise or grow (育): growing your body, P.E. class.
宅 has a roof (宀) on top: a roof over you, your house.
球 means ball: a round たま, like a ball you throw.
弾 has bow (弓) on the left: what flies from a bow or gun, a bullet.
Look into (調) + check (査): checking things carefully, a survey or investigation.
続 means continue: the part that continues, the sequel.
That (当) + time (時): at that time, in those days.
Year (年) + age (齢, which has tooth 歯): count years like teeth, your age.
Farming (農) + house (家): a farming house, a farmer's family.
Hand out (配) + reach (達): handing things out until they reach you, delivery.
Judge (評) + value (価): judging the value of something, an evaluation.
Lady (婦, has woman 女) + person (人): a woman, a lady.
Section (部) + divide (分): a divided section, a part.
Change (変) + change again (更): changing the plan, a modification.
Three lines (heaven, people, earth) joined by one line: the king who connects them.
境 has earth (土) on the left: where one piece of land ends, the border.
Wood (木) under a roof (广): the wooden floor of a house.
棒 has tree (木) on the left: a long piece of wood, a pole or stick.
景 (view) + light rays (彡): where the light is blocked, a shadow.
九 with a dot: picture a dot rolling round and round, a circle, まる.
密 has a roof (宀) over a mountain (山): things packed close together, thick, dense.
例 has person (亻) on the left: one person shown as an example.
他 has person (亻): that other person over there, so "other".
A jewel (玉) under a roof (宀): treasure kept safe in the house.
他 has person (亻): someone else, so ほか means other, else.
Thing (事) + real (実): a real thing that happened, a fact.
Branch (支) + shop (店): a branch shop or office.
A little (少) twice (々): just a little bit, polite for 少し.
Nature (性) + standard (格): your nature, your character.
Become (成) + achievements (績): the results you achieve at school, your grades.
表 means surface: you bring feelings to the surface, to express.
Thought (意) + outside (外): outside what you thought, unexpected.
今 means now: soon it will be "now", before long.
祝 has the altar sign (礻): praying at the altar for good things, a celebration.
Respond (応) + help (援): answering with help, cheering someone on.
Value (価) + standard (格): the set value, the price.
Wake up (覚) + realize (悟): you see clearly and are ready, resolution.
House (家) + work or matter (事): house work, housework.
Set time (期) + interval (間): the time between two points, a period.
Discuss (議) + argue (論): talking ideas through, a discussion.
Go (行) + move (動): going and moving, your actions.
Mistake (誤) + understand (解): understanding wrongly, a misunderstanding.
Black (黒) + board (板): a blackboard.
断 means cut off: you cut off the request, you refuse.
向 means face toward: the place facing you, across the street.
Role (役) + divide (割): dividing up the roles, your part or duty.
豊 looks like a dish piled high with food: plenty, rich.
Stand in for (代) + show (表): someone who stands in for the group, a representative.
Carry on your shoulder (担) + assigned (当): the job on your shoulders, in charge.
Land (地) + direction (方): land out in some direction, a region.
Stay (駐, has horse 馬) + car (車): where horses once stopped, now cars, parking.
Top of the head (頂) + up (上): the very top, the summit.
伝 means pass on: to be passed on, handed down.
Wide (博) + things (物) + building (館): a building with a wide range of things, a museum.
減 has water (氵): the water level going down, to decrease.
胸 has the body part sign (月): the body part at the front, the chest.
素 has thread (糸) at the bottom: raw thread, the plain basic stuff, the base.
腹 has the body part sign (月): the belly.
穴 has a roof (宀) with an opening (八): a cave, a hole.
可 means can, OK: a grade that says "OK, you pass".
肩 has the body part sign (月) under 戸: the body part at the top of your arm, the shoulder.
Person (亻) + stand (立): where a person stands, their rank.
Child (子) + line (系): the child who continues the family line, a grandchild.
Point (指) + guide (導): pointing the way and guiding, coaching.
Borrow (借) + money (金): borrowed money, debt.
Take up (就) + job (職): taking up a job, finding work.
Live (住) + house (宅): a house you live in, housing.
Heavy (重) + needed (要): heavy and needed, important.
Fix (修) + put in order (理): fixing it properly, repair.
Main (主) + stretch (張): stretching out your main point, a claim.
章 has sound (音) on top: a piece of music or writing, a chapter.
Item (条) + matter (件): the items you must meet, the conditions.
State (状) + look (態): how things look now, the condition.
Heart (心) + body organ (臓): the heart.
Hits (当たり) right in front (前) of you: so obvious, of course.
合 means fit together: to put together, to combine.
Stretch (延) + set date (期): stretching the date out, postponement.
幼 is small thread (幺) + power (力): little strength, very young.
飾 has food (食) on the left: like making food look nice, decoration.
Lively (活) + leap (躍): leaping into lively action, being active.
Pass (過) + stage (程): the stages you pass through, the process.
Be ill (患) + person (者): a person who is ill, a patient.
Machine (機) + ability (能): what a machine can do, its function.
Money (金) + amount (額): the amount of money.
詳 has words (言): lots of words that give detail, detailed.
Country (国) + people (民): the people of a country, citizens.
Most (最) + end (終): the very end, the last.
支 means support: like a branch holding something up, to support.
Land (土) + product (産): a product from the place you visited, a souvenir.
Not yet (未) + come (来): what has not come yet, the future.
Command (命) + order (令): an order you must follow, a command.
Excuse (免) + allow (許): officially allowed to do something, a license.
燃 has fire (火): on fire, to burn.
Eye (目) + mark (標): the mark you keep your eye on, a target.
After (後) + regret (悔): the bad feeling that comes after, regret.
Before (先) + day (日): a day before now, the other day.
Low (氐) under a roof (广): the lowest part, the bottom.
In exchange for (代) + money (金): the money you give in exchange, the price.
Catch up to (逮) + capture (捕): chase and catch, an arrest.
助 has power (力): giving your power to someone, to help.
試 means try or test: a try, a trial.
Single (単) + word (語): a single word, vocabulary.
単 means single, simple: simply, merely.
Ground (地) + below (下): below the ground, underground or basement.
Know (知) + ability (能): the ability to know, intelligence.
Tune (調): how well you are tuned today, your condition.
務 has power (力): putting your strength into work, your duty.
Plum (梅) + rain (雨): the rain that comes when plums ripen, rainy season.
Stop (停) + electricity (電): the power stops, a blackout.
Stop (停) + stay (留) + place (所): the place where buses stop and wait.
Throw (投) + ballot slip (票): throwing in your paper slip, voting.
共 means together: together, with each other.
抜 has hand (扌): pull out with your hand, to extract.
Plum (梅, ばい) + rain (雨, う): plum rain, the rainy season.
Show (表) + feeling (情): feelings shown on your face, a facial expression.
Comment (評) + judgment (判): what people judge about you, your reputation.
No (無) + matter (事): nothing bad happened, safe and sound.
Normal (普) + step (段): your normal steps, usually.
打 has hand (扌): strike with your hand, to hit.
増 has earth (土): adding more earth to the pile, to increase.
振 has hand (扌): moving your hand back and forth, to wave or shake.
Treasure (宝) + stone (石): a treasure stone, a jewel.
True (真) + resemble (似): making it look like the real one, imitation.
し is death; that is why 4 (し) is an unlucky number in Japan.
例 means example: たとえ, for example.
良 means good: よい is the formal form of いい, good.
鬼 is a figure with a big scary head (田 shape): an ogre, a demon.
量 means measure: how much there is, the amount.
碗 has stone (石): a stone or pottery bowl.
根 has tree (木): the part of the tree under the ground, the root.
Fire (火) + rice field (田): a field cleared with fire, a dry farm field.
骨 has the body part sign (月) at the bottom: the hard part of the body, bone.
印 means stamp, mark: a mark or sign that shows something.
Water (水) with an extra dot: water that has frozen, ice.
縁 has thread (糸): a thread tying people together, a relationship or fate.
種 has grain (禾): a grain you plant, a seed.
縁 has thread (糸): the thread sewn along the edge, the rim.
Time (時) + carve (刻): a time marked like a notch, the exact time.
Matter (事) + feeling (情): the facts and feelings around it, the circumstances.
実 means real, true: truly, indeed.
Use (使) + use (用): using something, use.
State (状) + situation (況): the state of things, the situation.
Accept (承) + recognize (認): accepting and recognizing, approval.
Proof (証) + clear (明): making it clear with proof, verification.
Person (人) + craft (工): made by people's work, artificial.
Examine (診) + inspect (察): the doctor checks you, a medical exam.
Close (親) + friend (友): a close friend.
Too much (贅) + plenty (沢): far more than needed, luxury.
World (世) + between (間): the space between people in the world, society.
Each other (相) + not changing (変わらず): still not changed, as usual.
明 means bright: clear as bright light, obvious.
今にも is "even now": it could happen even now, any moment.
穏 means calm: calm and gentle.
主 means main: mainly.
Warm (温) + degree (度): degrees of warmth, temperature.
Meet (会) + count (計): counting the money together, the accounts or bill.
換 has hand (扌): swap something from hand to hand, to exchange.
香 is grain (禾) over sun (日): the smell of grain in the sun, a fragrance.
必ず means always: with しも and a negative, not always.
Can (可) + ability (能): you have the ability, so it is possible.
Rest (休) + catch your breath (憩, has 息): a break.
Money (金) + storehouse (庫): a store for money, a safe.
Bitter (苦) + labour (労): hard, bitter work, hardship.
Punishment (刑) + matter (事): crime matters, a police detective.
Examine (検) + check (査): checking carefully, an inspection.
Build (建) + construct (築): building, architecture.
Romantic love (恋) + person (人): the person you love, a lover.
Cross (交) + swap (換): swapping things across, an exchange.
超 has run (走): run past the line, to exceed.
Breathe out (呼) + breathe in (吸): out and in, breathing.
